scope: Strict recursive instance validation followed by canonical JSON and UTF-8 representability at inspected public consumers in 23 implementation files

independent_review.initial_block: Direct validation alone admitted lone-surrogate reply strings, unlike the former JSON boundary; imports could reach filesystem creation.
independent_review.fix: Validate original Python types first, then encode canonical JSON as UTF-8 before consumption or I/O.
independent_review.extra_probes: Forged bools and unknown fields refuse before serialization; lone surrogates refuse; ASCII, actual emoji, accented text and NUL preserve roundtrips and recording digests.

mutations.method: Isolated source copies; each mutant compiled; each baseline had 3 passing tests; each mutant had 1 named failure and 2 passing controls.

installed_wheel.environment: site-packages import outside checkout with PYTHONPATH unset
installed_wheel.boundary_probes: passed: Boolean policy refusal, valid emoji import, surrogate and extra-field refusal before directories exist

limits: No Scala gate run for this Python-only change
No scientific accuracy or full-port parity claim
Independent reviewer did not repeat full suite or mutation runs
